title: One-dimensional Bloch, Wannier, and tight-binding reduction exercise
status_detail: Explicitly selected and activated by the human. A calculated isolated-band mini-paper retains independent parent refinements, structural checks, direct localization, hopping reconstruction, finite-range and route comparisons. Its passing adversarial suite covers seven amplitudes, eight bands, mesh refinement, modified real potentials, gauge attacks, and changed fitting objectives. A second calculated mini-paper verifies direct two-band composite polar transport for bands 0--1 and 2--3, overlap conditioning, Wilson-loop covariance, controlled U(2) alignment recovery, matrix hopping reconstruction, gauge-dependent locality, and direct-versus-mediated block reduction; its independent verifier passes. The human authorized the optional local Wannier90 comparison and one search_shells=130 retry after the first low-pair preprocessing failure. Both corrected preprocessing and localization stages completed within their resource envelopes, and the independently verified exported frames align with the direct represented operators. Neither localization satisfied the frozen spread convergence criterion within 500 iterations, so the outputs remain nonconverged diagnostics rather than localization references. The human authorized the bounded num_iter=5000 study at checkpoint RM-PERIODIC-1D-W90-CONVERGENCE-HC04. Both preprocessing stages completed, but low_pair reached 5000 iterations without satisfying the unchanged convergence rule; the declared stop condition prevented higher_pair localization. The human authorized both preconditioned runs at checkpoint RM-PERIODIC-1D-W90-PRECONDITIONED-HC06, adding only precond=true to the fixed 5000-iteration inputs. Low_pair and higher_pair satisfied the unchanged spread convergence rule at iterations 69 and 4176. Verified common-frame operators agree within 4.9e-10 E_G; center-set discrepancies are 2.16e-7 and 2.63e-3 cell, with the higher-pair difference retained under weak external isolation. The Task remains active at checkpoint RM-PERIODIC-1D-ACCEPTANCE-HC07 pending final human acceptance; no additional Wannier90 execution is authorized. No result has been human accepted, and semiconductor validation, UQ, additional external execution, and successor activation are not claimed.
objective: Develop the one-dimensional cosine-lattice exercise spanning Bloch fibers, independent plane-wave and real-space representations, retained subspaces, localization, hopping reconstruction, and direct-versus-mediated tight-binding reduction.
authorized_scope: Plan independently refined plane-wave and finite-difference Bloch representations with exact symmetry and perturbative checks.
Transport representations into common low-mode or retained-band coordinates before operator comparison.
Develop isolated- and composite-band gauge, localization, hopping-range, withheld-data, and direct-versus-mediated reduction exercises one controlled complication at a time.
completion_criteria: Parent-representation, reciprocal-sampling, retained-subspace, gauge, localization, hopping-truncation, fitting, and observable-extraction errors remain separately reported.
Reconstruction, symmetry, projector, overlap-conditioning, and route-comparison checks are executable under frozen illustrative inputs.
Any optional comparison with Wannier90 requires separate execution authority and remains numerical verification of the cosine model, not material validation.
exclusions: No silicon-specific parent, Quantum ESPRESSO execution, production Wannierization, scientific validation, or public scientific API freeze is authorized.
Agreement between two unconverged representations is not accepted as convergence.
The tight-binding model is not described as converging directly to the scalar potential.
